title: JFK briefed at Los Alamos

tellings.quote: And then JFK, I think a couple weeks later, a few weeks later, ends up at Los Alamos getting briefed.

plain: In 1962 President John F. Kennedy is said to have gone to Los Alamos, the government laboratory in New Mexico, to be briefed, a few weeks after some earlier event Michels does not spell out. Michels tells this himself, a little unsure ("I think a couple weeks later"), in an episode with the lawyer Danny Sheehan about Kennedy and UFOs. Michels raises it because it would suggest Kennedy was being told secret things.
